name: two-agent-allocation-template
description: Minimal two-agent template: a proposer suggests how to split a shared resource pool and a reviewer responds. Replace materials, prompts, and models with your study's own.
sharedMaterials: Two teams share a pool of 100 credits for the coming cycle. Team North runs the archive; Team South runs the workshop. Any credits left unallocated are lost.

agents.name: Proposer
agents.systemPrompt: You represent Team North. Propose an allocation of the shared credits and justify it briefly.

agents.name: Reviewer
agents.systemPrompt: You represent Team South. Evaluate the proposal you receive and state whether you accept it, with one revision if you decline.

turns.title: Proposal
turns.promptTemplate: Propose a split of the 100 credits between Team North and Team South. State the numbers first, then at most three sentences of justification.

turns.title: Review
turns.promptTemplate: You have read the proposal above. Accept or decline it. State your decision on its own line, exactly as 'Decision: accept' or 'Decision: decline'. If you decline, give exactly one revised split and one sentence explaining the revision.
